pacura.p: [Paci+ura] (ti) CL=8 Paci vitthāre uro, pacuraṃ. Dhāna,ṭī.7va3.pa+cura+a. Thoma.]. many, poly or many.
a: ပစိ ဝိတ္ထာရေ ဥရော၊ ပစုရံ။ ဓာန်၊ဋီ။၇ဝ၃။ပ+စုရ+အ။ ထောမ။] အများ၊ များသော။

pacura： pacura（ti）

[paci+ura．paci vitthāre uro，pacuraṃ．，ṭī．7va3．pa+cura+a．thoma．]
[ပစိ+ဥရ။ ပစိ ဝိတ္ထာရေ ဥရော၊ ပစုရံ။ ဓာန်၊ဋီ။၇ဝ၃။ပ+စုရ+အ။ ထောမ။]
P: Pacura，（adj．） [cp．late Sk．pracura] general，various，any； abundant，many J．V，40 （=bahu salabha C．）； Miln．408 （°jana） Dāvs．IV，11，50； VvA．213 （°jano for yādisakīdiso Vv 50<sup>11</sup>）．See also pasura．（Page 383）

[ပစိ+ဥရ။ ပစိ ဝိတ္ထာရေ ဥရော၊ ပစုရံ။ ဓာန်၊ဋီ။၇ဝ၃။ပ+စုရ+အ။ ထောမ။]

R:
pacura：ပစုရ （တိ）
များသော။ များစွာသော။
DOP: pacura mfn. [ S. pracura], abundant, many; frequent; general, normal; Abh 703 (bhūri pahūtaṃ ~aṃ); A III 172, 23 (kālagatā c’ assa atthā ~ā honti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se paripūrā; Mp III 291, 25 foll.: atthā … paṭhamavayasmiṃ yeva āgacchanti c’ eva bahū ca honti); Ja V 40, 25* (ye keci mānusā kāmā … sabbe te ~ā mayhaṃ; 40, 26´ : ~ā ti bahū sulabhā); 90, 28* (yaṃ kiñci manas’ icchasi sabbaṃ taṃ ~aṃ mayhaṃ); VI 134, 8* (~ā kira hotha yaññatthāya, Be so; Ce, Ee pasurā; Se pasu; 134, 11´ : ekasmiṃ ṭhāne rāsī hothā ti ācikkhathā ti); — pacurena, adv. , generally, normally; Thī-a 6, 6 (~ena anvatthasaññābhāvato); — °’- attha , m. and mfn. [pacura + attha 2 ], 1. ( m. ) the meaning of abundant, frequent; Sp 227, 9 (paṭisevatī ti °-paṭisevano hoti ~e vattamānavacanaṃ); — 2. ( mfn. ) having abundant benefits; well-off; A IV 94, 25 foll. (sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati aho vatāyaṃ na ~o assā ti … na bhikkhave sapatto sapattassa ~-tāya nandati; Mp IV 48, 3 : ~-tāyā ti bahu-atthatāya bahuhitatāya); — °- jana , m. [pacura + jana 1 ], an ordinary person; the mass of people; Mil 408, 31 (pavanaṃ suññaṃ ~ehi); It-a II 75, 5 ; Vv-a 213, 18 (yādisakīdiso ti yo vā so vā, ~o ti attho); Cp-a 319, 25 (yaṃ na ~ā sotuṃ pi sakkuṇanti pag eva paṭipajjituṃ); Sadd 808, 7 ; — °- vohāra , m. , normal usage, general practice; Sp 671, 4 (~-vasena); Nidd-a I 297, 5 (~ena vattabbo vacanamatten’ eva adhippāyassa nītattā nīto) = Paṭis-a 647, 24 ; — neg. apacuravohāra, appacuravohāra, m. , Nidd-a I 297, 4 = Paṭis-a 647, 22 .
